description: A windowless block of breeze-block painted arterial red. The cherry in pink neon over the door has lost its stem and half its lower curve, so what actually buzzes up there is a lopsided circle. The door is padded vinyl, gone tacky under a hundred thousand hands. Bass comes through the wall as pressure rather than sound, and the gravel at the kerb glitters with the foil off a decade of cheap drinks. The door is west; Cinder Lane runs east.
name: The Cherry Pit
